News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings | Nov. 17 07:33 AM November 17, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 07:33 AM November 17, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — US President Donald Trump’s expected arrival in Manila takes center stage as the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit enters its final day on Tuesday, Nov. 17.
His visit comes as Southeast Asian leaders wrap up their meetings, with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. set to lead the closing ceremony and hand over the Asean chairship to Singapore.
The Department of Foreign Affairs has said the summit program will proceed as scheduled despite the late arrival of the US president.
Trump’s arrival is also expected to draw protests from groups opposing his visit and the proposed US-led Pax Silica initiative.
Follow our live updates for the latest developments, key statements, agreements and other developments from Manila./dp
